name: Raycasting Step Size & Aspect Ratio Normalization
aliases: Fixed-Step Ray Marching with Steps Per Voxel
definition: Computes normalized step sizes and a scaling factor to map arbitrary volume dimensions and aspect ratios into a unit cube coordinate system for uniform ray marching.
summary: This method ensures consistent sampling density by normalizing volume dimensions to a unit cube, distinguishing itself from adaptive or analytical approaches through the use of constant intervals.
